messages.context: Rabbit Uncle 运行时实测台词
messages.raw: §fCuz might not have the typical athlete's discipline, but he's clutch.
messages.text: Cuz might not have the typical athlete's discipline, but he's clutch.
messages.zh: Cuz 或许没有典型运动员的自律,但关键时刻绝对靠得住。

messages.context: Rabbit Uncle 运行时实测台词
messages.raw: §fJust like my old teammate who didn't show up to every practice, but could score tuddies when it mattered most.
messages.text: Just like my old teammate who didn't show up to every practice, but could score tuddies when it mattered most.
messages.zh: 就像我以前那个队友:不是每次训练都来,可到了紧要关头总能达阵得分。
